title.en: Makanukku Ezhuthiya Kaditham (மகனுக்கு எழுதிய கடிதம்) by Na. Muthukumar

text.en: A father writes to his son about the world he is growing into.

This is a letter in modern Tamil by Na. Muthukumar. The lesson begins by recalling how people sent messages from smoke and sound signals to letters and now to e-mail, and shows that the form of communication keeps changing.
The letter shows a father's thoughts and advice for his son, and how letters carry feelings. It encourages the habit of writing letters.
Learn the parts of a letter: address, date, salutation, body, closing and signature. Terms: கடிதம் (letter), மின்னஞ்சல் (e-mail) and அஞ்சல் (post).
